name: Resend
tagline: Email API for developers to send transactional messages
description: Resend is a developer-first email API for sending transactional and marketing emails. It provides REST endpoints for messages, domains, audiences, and templates, with SDKs and React Email support. Built for reliable delivery, webhook events, and modern developer workflows rather than full inbox or CRM suites.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer re_xxxxxxxxx header; create keys in the Resend dashboard after signup.

use_cases: send a transactional email after user signup
send password reset or magic-link email
send order confirmation or receipt email
verify domain DNS for production sending
list or inspect sent email delivery status
